description: Leto, la deidad madre de Apolo y Artemisa, tiene vinculado su nombre a la palabra “olvido”, siendo asociada muchas veces a la revelación de lo oculto. En este sentido presentamos a LETO, un software que invita a olvidarse de aquellos objetos presentes constantemente a nuestro alrededor, pues es LETO quien busca prestar su ayuda a encontrar aquello que aguarda a ser descubierto en nuestro cosmos tan vasto.
summary:
Hola! Mi nombre es Mele, y junto a Maia y a Camila creamos LETO. Inspiradas en la deidad madre de Apolo y Artemisa, presentamos nuestro software, que busca encontrar aquello que aguarda a ser descubierto en nuestro vasto cosmos.

Utilizando las imágenes de la misión Sphere X, de la NASA, y creamos una web donde el usuario puede introducir coordenadas celestes y se le proporcionará una serie de imágenes tomadas a lo largo del tiempo en distintas bandas de infrarrojo para ver la evolución de dicho espacio celeste, sus astros y su espectro.

Hello! We are Mele, Maia and Camila, and together, we created LETO. Inspired by Leto, the mother of Apollo and Artemis, we developed a software platform designed to uncover the wonders waiting to be discovered in our vast cosmos.
Using images from NASA’s SPHEREx mission, we developed a web-based platform where users can input celestial coordinates and explore a series of images captured over time across different infrared bands. This allows the user to observe the evolution of a particular region of the sky, the celestial objects within it and its spectra.
details:
Hello! We are Mele, Maia and Camila, and together, we created Leto!

Leto is the mother goddess of Apollo and Artemis. Her name is associated with the word “forgetfulness”, and she is often linked to the revelation of hidden things. Inspired by this, we present LETO, a software platform designed to help uncover what awaits discovery in our vast cosmos.

Our software allows users to enter their desired celestial coordinates and retrieve a series of images captured over time in different infrared bands, directly from NASA's SPHEREx mission databases. This enables users to observe the evolution of a specific region of the sky and the celestial objects it contains.

Furthermore, by using images across different infrared bands, our website generates the spectrum of a given region at different points in time, making changes in its emission and absorption patterns clearly visible. The platform also allows users to generate false-color images of celestial objects and save them directly to their devices.

LETO's tools have a wide range of applications. They provide a detailed view of celestial objects within a region of interest and allow users to analyze changes in their celestial positions over time, as well as the evolution of the region's spectrum. This makes LETO potentially useful for a variety of scientific investigations, ranging from the detection of new celestial objects to the analysis of the evolution of stellar magnetic activity cycles.

Another key advantage of our platform is that, since it is directly connected to SPHEREx database servers, it will not require manual updates to incorporate future data releases into scientific studies. This ensures immediate access to new images and the ability to analyze them as soon as they become available.

In the future, we aim to further develop and expand our platform, providing users with an even more comprehensive experience, featuring a greater number of images and faster processing. Our ultimate goal is to make LETO a valuable tool for a wide range of astrophysical research and related fields.
